非正質量、非有限入力、G≠1、不適切な格子・正弦モード、非整数箱長移動を拒否。質量・内力和・自己力の一致だけでは個々の粒子力の精度を保証しない。周期直接和、短距離補正、Ewald・P3M・PME・SPME、粒子時間発展は実装しない。 配布版のソースとテスト 同じ配布版で共有するファイルを含みます。すべてがこの問題専用のコードや検査という意味ではありません。 ソース Conditions, commands and validation scope Assumptions Three-dimensional periodic cube L=1, G=1, 24³ mesh and positive masses summing to one. All positions/masses are stored explicitly; no runtime random generation. Continuum-k² FFT inversion with matched CIC assignment/interpolation. Use these commands in the working directory specified by the execution guide after extracting the ZIP. A command may execute several cases in the package. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python run_recipe.py --input recipes/periodic-particles.json --output output-periodic-particles python -m pytest -q tests/test_recipes.py Validation limits Reject nonpositive masses, nonfinite inputs, G!=1, invalid grids/sinusoidal modes and noninteger box shifts. Mass/net-force/self-force consistency alone does not establish individual particle-force accuracy. No periodic pair-sum reference, short-range correction, Ewald/P3M/PME/SPME or particle evolution.
